description: Clean Architecture Solution Template by Minimdev. Features layered architecture (Core, Infrastructure, Presentation), .NET 10 support, Refresh Token system, Integration Tests, and full Visual Studio 2022 & 2026 compatibility via 'dotnet new' or New Project dialog.
releaseNotes: v1.7.0 GA: Comprehensive production-ready template release featuring Permission-Based Access Control (PBAC) with dynamic policy provider and role permission matrix, In-App Notification system with interactive topbar bell panel, App Settings / Feature Flags management with in-memory caching, Enhanced Audit Logs with timeline and diff views, and resilient UI double-submit guards.
title: Clean Architecture Solution Template
